provenance.document: SOMECS Input -- SOMECS SW brief tutorial (EN)
provenance.how: Transcribed by hand from the screenshot embedded in the PDF (792 x 705 px), enlarged 4-5x. Values are printed with three decimals; the screenshot is the only record.
provenance.what_it_shows: SOMECS's Matrix Horizontal Model Estimation module, n-dimensions = 10, 'symmetrical matrix' ticked: one generated matrix ('Generated dissimilarity matrices of n-dimensions'), its 2-D coordinates ('Coordinates in reduced dimensions'), and the start of a list of Spearman rank correlation coefficients, one per generated matrix.
provenance.caveat: The list is scrolled to its top while the progress bar reads 0.074 %; which list entry belongs to the displayed matrix is not shown. The diagonal is 1.000, so despite the label the values behave as similarities.
